Subject: Confidential: Manager stepwise intervention template and legal check

Hi Laura + Marissa —

Attaching a manager-facing template I drafted to standardize how we open sensitive performance pathways. Goal is to give managers a clear, stepwise script and timeline while ensuring we hit HR and legal guardrails before any formal notice. Key asks:

- Laura: can HR confirm the timeline (30/60/90) and the required check-ins and escalation points? Also please confirm were aligned with our standard documentation retention and coaching-record policies.
- Marissa: any legal flags (wording that could read as termination promise, disciplinary language to avoid, or suggested mandatory review language) would be great.

I tried to keep the template modular: optional coaching step, formal performance targets, support plan, and a clear end-of-path options matrix. I plan to use this for a conversation next week with an individual contributor on the Web Infra team (manager is Samir) but will not share until HR/legal ok.

Attachments: stepwise_intervention_template_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks — appreciate quick eyes on this given timeline.

Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

Jonas —

Thanks for pulling this together. Solid foundation; a few HR-driven edits I made are attached and summarized below:

- Standardize to a 45/30/15 check cadence (initial coaching week, 30-day formal review, 60-day focused improvement, 90-day final evaluation) — reasons: gives consistent documentation windows and aligns with our current corrective-action guidelines.
- Added required fields for accommodations and checklist to confirm ADA review if performance is linked to disability-related concerns.
- Added a required line to route the final plan to HR case intake (HR-CASE-2027-####) once the plan is delivered to the employee.
- Suggested manager prep items: replicate the last three performance artifacts and one positive behavior example for balance.

Ive attached stepwise_intervention_template_v1_LA_edits.docx with HR comments in the right margin. Two operational items:

1) We should schedule a 30-minute calibration with managers running these tracks. I can host a session next Tue 10–10:30am PT.
2) Please do not share the template with the manager or employee until legal reviews the language flagged below.

Attachments: stepwise_intervention_template_v1_LA_edits.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Confidential: Manager stepwise intervention template and legal check

Jonas / Laura —

Quick legal read. Overall okay to proceed with HRs cadence but please note the following redlines (attached as a redline doc):

- Avoid definitive language that can be construed as promised outcome. Replace "will be placed on a PIP" with "a formal performance pathway will be initiated".
- Insert a short paragraph about the employees right to representation/advocate in jurisdictions where applicable, and a cross-ref to our accommodations process.
- Add a clause indicating that the plan is not a change to at-will status (where relevant), and that timelines are target milestones rather than guarantees.

Suggested insertion (for the template):
"This performance pathway is intended to provide structured support and documentation to help the employee meet role expectations. It is not a promise of continued employment and does not change the employee's at-will status."

I attached stepwise_intervention_template_v1_legal_redline.docx with inline notes. One procedural ask: when this goes live, ensure we maintain a signed receipt from the employee (acknowledgment) and upload to the HR case folder (HR-CASE-2027-1472).

Marissa Cole
Employment Counsel
Redwood Inference
